name: institute-management-system
description: Full-stack Institute Management System with React frontend and Node.js backend

scripts.ims: concurrently --names "IMS-API,EMS-API,UI" --prefix-colors "blue,yellow,green" "npm run backend" "npm run ems" "npm run frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "IMS-API,EMS-API,UI" --prefix-colors "blue,yellow,green" "npm run backend:start" "npm run ems:start" "npm run frontend:start"
scripts.i: npm install && cd IMS_BACKEND && npm install && cd ../IMS_FRONTEND && npm install
